name: Mizjah Ruins
summary: In northern Stranglethorn Vale, Mosh'Ogg ogres have taken shelter in the Mizjah Ruins, southeast of Grom'gol Base Camp. They ambush supply caravans bound for the Swamp of Sorrows.

sections.title: A Den of Ogres
sections.body: The Gurubashi Empire raised the Mizjah Ruins long before modern empires rose. Now Mosh'Ogg ogres dwell among the cracked stones, including brute warriors and crude witch doctors. They raid supply convoys bound for the Horde settlement of Stonard. Their attacks trouble Grom'gol's commanders.

faq.answer: Jungle trolls of the Gurubashi Empire built the Mizjah Ruins long before modern empires rose. Centuries of warfare and ruin left them empty.

faq.q: Who lives in the Mizjah Ruins now?
faq.answer: Mosh'Ogg ogres now occupy the ruins, including Mosh'Ogg Brutes and Mosh'Ogg Witch Doctors. They have fortified the stone structures as a local encampment.

faq.q: Why is the Horde interested in clearing the ruins?
faq.answer: Mosh'Ogg ogres ambush Horde convoys traveling between Grom'gol Base Camp and Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows.

angles.text: Mosh'Ogg ogres at Mizjah threaten Horde supply lines. Grom'gol Base Camp sends warriors to guard the route to Stonard.
